problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization on R^d, permitting nonconvex objectives. The gradient is L-Lipschitz, the Hessian is ρ-Lipschitz in operator norm, and a global lower bound m satisfies f(x0)−m≤Δ.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query (x, none) returns an unbiased stochastic gradient g(x,ξ), with a fresh independent sample. No function values or sample reuse are supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedHessianVector.lean: spec.Query and spec.admissible oracle answer and gradient unbiasedness; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: A query (x, some v) returns an unbiased stochastic Hessian-vector product H(x,ξ)v. Each gradient or Hessian-vector response counts as one call against the same fixed budget. Full Hessian access is not supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedHessianVector.lean: spec.Query and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For public p∈(1,2], E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^p≤σg^p and E‖(H(x,ξ)−∇²f(x))v‖^p≤σh^p‖v‖^p for every x,v. The Hessian noise bound is directional, not an operator-norm moment bound. Variances may be infinite when p<2. Sample matrices need not be symmetric or derivatives of a common random loss.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedHessianVector.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible moment bounds and declaration of H

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space R^d with positive finite dimension d and its Euclidean norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Oracle seeds are IID across calls. All parameters are public: d, Ω, L, ρ, σg, σh, p, Δ, ε and x0; L,ρ,ε>0 and σg,σh,Δ≥0. The objective, estimators and sampling law are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedHessianVector.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The returned point x must satisfy ‖∇f(x)‖≤ε.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: The output is measurable and satisfies both stationarity conditions jointly with probability at least 2/3 over algorithm and oracle randomness, within a fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: At the same returned point, ⟨v,∇²f(x)v⟩≥−√(ρε)‖v‖² for every v, equivalently λmin(∇²f(x))≥−√(ρε).

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The second-order stationarity target is standard, but the oracle permits infinite-variance noise with only directional p-moment control of Hessian-vector errors, without sample symmetry, common-loss structure or sample reuse.
